# ScopeSwell — Pay-Per-Reach Instagram Story Marketplace

> ScopeSwell Marketing & Documentation Hub (https://scopeswell.space) is the official information portal for the automated performance marketplace. The web app platform is hosted at https://scopeswell.com, connecting verified Instagram creators with businesses, e-commerce brands, and local venues to share sponsored 24-hour Instagram Stories, paid strictly per verified unique account reached with automated escrow protection.

## Canonical Domain & Access
- Platform Information & Guides: https://scopeswell.space
- Official Web Application: https://scopeswell.com
- Fixed Payment Rates: https://scopeswell.space/#rates
- Escrow & Business Protection: https://scopeswell.space/#business-guide
- Interactive Live Assistant: https://scopeswell.space/#ai-instructor
- Security & Verification Audit: https://scopeswell.space/#security
- FAQs: https://scopeswell.space/#faqs

## Core Economics & Currency Parity
- Platform Currency: Credits (1 Credit = €1.00 EUR fixed parity).
- Creator Rates: Fixed between €0.03 and €0.08 per verified unique account reached based on tier and city.
  - Tallinn / Baltic tier: €0.03 per verified reach
  - Helsinki / Nordic tier: €0.05 per verified reach
  - Stockholm / Western EU tier: €0.06 - €0.08 per verified reach
- Minimum Payout Threshold: €20.00 EUR directly to bank account, IBAN, or digital wallet.
- Escrow Protection: Business budgets are pre-funded into automated escrow. Businesses only pay for actual unique accounts reached. Unused budget is refunded immediately upon 24-hour audit.

## Story Posting & Verification Process
1. Accept Campaign: Creator accepts a brand campaign matching their niche on https://scopeswell.com.
2. 30-Second Professional Account: Creator ensures Instagram account is switched to Creator/Professional (Settings > Account type > Switch to professional account).
3. Post 24-Hour Story: Post the approved story with brand tag, link sticker, or promo code. Keep live for the full 24 hours.
4. Insights Screenshot: After 24h expires, creator captures a screenshot of Instagram Story Insights showing "Accounts Reached".
5. Automated Audit & Payout: AI proof verification confirms unique reach and releases EUR funds from escrow into creator wallet.
